_about: Tooltip text for the Trends page. Each trend tooltip shows: meaning, counted, an auto-generated example line from the most recent game that fit, then the footer.
footer: Records cover this season's graded games. Past results don't predict future ones.

direction.Back: Back = bet the teams in this spot.
direction.Fade: Fade = bet against them, meaning their opponent.

home_fav.title: Home favorites
home_fav.meaning: The home team is favored to win the segment.
home_fav.counted: Every game where the home side's price was shorter than the road side's.

road_dog.title: Road underdogs
road_dog.meaning: The road team is the underdog.
road_dog.counted: Same games as home favorites, from the road side.

home_dog.title: Home underdogs
home_dog.meaning: The home team is the underdog.
home_dog.counted: Every game where the road team was favored.

road_fav.title: Road favorites
road_fav.counted: Same games as home underdogs, from the road side.

tier1.title: Big favorites
tier1.counted: Graded at the saved price for that side.

tier2.title: Small favorites
tier2.counted: Graded at the saved price for that side.

tier3.title: Small underdogs
tier3.counted: Graded at the saved price for that side.

tier4.title: Big underdogs
tier4.counted: Graded at the saved price for that side.

b2b.title: Teams on a back-to-back
b2b.meaning: The team played yesterday; its opponent didn't.
b2b.counted: Games where only one team is on zero days of rest.

b2b_opp.title: Opponents of a back-to-back team
b2b_opp.meaning: The other team played yesterday; this one is rested.
b2b_opp.counted: Same games, from the rested side.

rested.title: Rested teams
rested.meaning: The team has more days off than its opponent.
rested.counted: Games where one team has the rest edge, from that side.

tired.title: Tired teams
tired.meaning: The team has fewer days off than its opponent.
tired.counted: Same games, from the side with less rest.

off_loss.title: Teams off a loss
off_loss.meaning: The team lost its last game.

off_loss3.title: Teams off a blowout
off_loss3.meaning: The team lost its last game by 3+ goals.

off_shutout.title: Teams off a shutout
off_shutout.meaning: The team was shut out last game.
off_shutout.counted: Last game ended with zero goals scored.

div.title: Divisional games
div.meaning: Both teams are in the same division.

nonconf.title: Non-conference games
nonconf.meaning: The teams are in different conferences.

rest_edge.title: Rest edge games
rest_edge.meaning: One team has more days off than the other.

even_rest.title: Even rest games
even_rest.meaning: Both teams have the same days off.

b2b_game.title: Back-to-back games
b2b_game.meaning: At least one team played yesterday.
b2b_game.counted: Games where either team has zero days of rest.

off_loss_game.title: Team off a loss
off_loss_game.meaning: At least one team lost its last game.

off_loss3_game.title: Team off a blowout
off_loss3_game.meaning: At least one team lost its last game by 3+ goals.

off_shutout_game.title: Team off a shutout
off_shutout_game.meaning: At least one team was shut out last game.
off_shutout_game.counted: Last game ended with zero goals scored.

home_fav_game.title: Home favorite games
home_fav_game.counted: Every game where the home price was shorter.

home_dog_game.title: Home underdog games
home_dog_game.counted: Every game where the road price was shorter.

market_notes.side: Ties and pushes don't count toward the record and are 0 units.
market_notes.game: Half-point totals and BTTS can't push; a whole-number total that lands exactly is a push.
market_notes.ml3: 3-way moneyline: a tied segment is its own outcome, so a team bet loses on a tie.

tug_of_war.label: Tug of war
tug_of_war.tooltip: One team leans Over (or BTTS Yes), the other leans Under (or No). Something has to give.

fireworks.label: Fireworks
fireworks.tooltip: Both teams lean Over (or BTTS Yes) this season.

lockdown.label: Lockdown
lockdown.tooltip: Both teams lean Under (or BTTS No) this season.

mismatch.label: Mismatch
mismatch.tooltip: One team usually wins the opening segment; the other usually loses it.

heavyweights.label: Heavyweights
heavyweights.tooltip: Both teams usually win the opening segment.

matchup_labels.lean_rule: A team leans a way when it hits that side in 60%+ of its games, with at least 10 games played.

streaks.section: Teams on a run of 3 or more straight in the opening segment, counted from their most recent game. A tie or push ends a streak.
streaks.colors: Win and loss streaks run green to red. Over/Under and Yes/No streaks get darker the longer they run.

record_line.tooltip: Wins and losses betting this trend this season, how often it won, how often the same bet won across all games, and profit risking 1 unit per bet at the prices RTYB saved.

todays_record: How this day's trend bets are doing, each bet counted once even if two trends point at it.
